label: Having a truth value: TruthApt φ: φ is the kind of sentence that can be true or false
definition: `TruthApt φ`: φ is the kind of sentence that can be true or false. O'Connor's own gloss, given with his emotivism; on it a sentence without truth value cannot be true (`LackingTruthValueExcludesTruthReading`).
